shape.title: the collection's name as the editor writes it
shape.by: the editor's name, shown as the credit under the heading
shape.note: optional: a line in the editor's own words, never written by an agent
plays: gut-<id> of a play in the library, in the editor's order; at least three, or it is not published
shape.season: optional: when it is shown, e.g. December
